mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:115-120: MODEL_BODY_HELM + i and its fellows load HelmClass{i+1}, ArmorClass{i+1} and the rest, and a character with no armour wears MODEL_BODY_* + SkinIndex (ZzzCharacter.cpp:12124-12346), numbered one over MU's zero-based classes -- so Class04 is the Magic Gladiator, class 3.
part_note: The head, 337 triangles. Bound to 215 on Bip01 Head, 12 on Bip01 Spine1. The Spine1 ring is taken onto the head by rebind, as on the other S17 heads.
sheet_from: Data/Player/HQSkin_special_01.OZJ (256x256), from the Season 17 client (third_party/MuClient_S17_v1.19.74). All five of the Magic Gladiator's parts name it.
cull_from: As HelmClass02: MU's hair is flat single-sided fins, and culled they wink out as the head turns (HelmClass02.json's cull_note).
model_from: Season 17's remake of MU's Magic Gladiator body, read out of Data/Player/HelmClass04.bmd in the S17 client: a version-14 file, which MuExtract opens through Webzen's ModulusCryptor (pipeline/MuExtract/MuAssets/Crypto). It replaced MuMain's HelmClass04 on 2026-10-15 at the user's call ("now fairy elf, then MG"). Its 51 bones are the first 51 of player.bmd's, by name and order, so it rides our rig and clips as MuMain's did.
rebind_from: As HelmClass02's: S17's head binds 215 vertices to Bip01 Head and a ring of 12 at the base of the neck to Bip01 Spine1, two joints down, and the head turns a long way from the chest in MU's poses (56 degrees in action 5), so a rigidly bound ring is wrung by all of it. Taken onto the head, as on every S17 head (the user, 2026-10-15).
uv_overrides_why: The face and the red mane share shells; the islands are hair and the face and neck are lifted out. Read off the sheet with the UV layout drawn over it (2026-10-15).
material_note: hair for the red feathered mane, skin for the face and neck.
